say:2:1321733001:0.text: Dura above... Honorable knight, surely you have come to deliver Dura's divine message and save Princess Yolena!
say:2:1321733001:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上……可敬的圣骑士，您一定是来传达艾雅的神谕、拯...

say:4:1321733003:0.text: I'm afraid you're mistaken. I am but a humble knight of the Temple, not one worthy of delivering divine revelations.
say:4:1321733003:0.source_cn: 恐怕您误会了，我只是一名普通的圣堂骑士，还不足以成为传...

say:5:1321733004:0.text: But then... why are you here at Valesa Castle?
say:5:1321733004:0.source_cn: 可是……那您为什么会来到瓦勒沙城堡呢？
say:5:1321733004:0.male: But then... why are you here at Valesa Castle?

say:7:1321733005:0.text: Silence, Lieutenant. This is not your place to speak.
say:7:1321733005:0.source_cn: 噤声，副官，不是你插嘴的时候。
say:7:1321733005:0.male: Silence, Lieutenant. This is not your place to speak.
say:7:1321733005:0.female: Silence, Lieutenant. This is not your place to speak.

say:10:1321733006:0.text: Miss Lydia, I must ask that you show respect to both <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Dame Temesia!
say:10:1321733006:0.male: Miss Lydia, I must ask that you show respect to both <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Dame Temesia!
say:10:1321733006:0.female: Miss Lydia, I must ask that you show respect to both <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Dame Temesia!

say:11:1321733007:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Dame Temesia have come to assist in the preparation of Her Highness' funeral—
say:11:1321733007:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Dame Temesia have come to assist in the preparation of Her Highness' funeral—
say:11:1321733007:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and Dame Temesia have come to assist in the preparation of Her Highness' funeral—

say:13:1321733009:0.text: Captain Rodrigo, Her Highness has always trusted you most, yet you dare speak such blasphemous words!
say:13:1321733009:0.source_cn: 罗德里戈，公主殿下向来最信任你，你竟然会吐出这么恶毒的诅咒！

say:14:1321733010:0.text: I shall report you directly to the Archduke if you utter another word of disrespect! He will have no choice but to order your punishment.
say:14:1321733010:0.source_cn: 如果你再多说一句诅咒殿下的话，我就立刻禀报给大公阁下，...

say:15:1321733011:0.text: The Archduke? But he has already—
say:15:1321733011:0.source_cn: 大公阁下？大公阁下他已经——
say:15:1321733011:0.male: The Archduke? But he has already—
say:15:1321733011:0.female: The Archduke? But he has already—

choice_prompt:16:1321733011.text: The Archduke? But he has already—
choice_prompt:16:1321733011.source_cn: 大公阁下？大公阁下他已经——
choice_prompt:16:1321733011.male: The Archduke? But he has already—
choice_prompt:16:1321733011.female: The Archduke? But he has already—

say:17:1321733014:0.text: ...I apologize. Her Highness' illness has left me unsettled. It feels like I've been trapped in a nightmare, one from which I have yet to awaken.
say:17:1321733014:0.source_cn: ……抱歉，最近公主殿下病重，我精神不济了。当做是我做了...

say:18:1321733015:0.text: I only wish to know why she is not in her chamber. The Archduke gave specific orders that she not leave her room without supervision.
say:18:1321733015:0.source_cn: 我只想知道，公主殿下为什么没在寝殿里？大公阁下明明下过...

say:19:1321733016:0.text: That is because Her Highness is participating in the festivities within the castle.
say:19:1321733016:0.source_cn: 那是因为殿下正在城堡里参加庆典。

say:20:1321733017:0.text: We've recreated many activities from the Snowspire Festival; you must have seen them when you arrived. Thanks to our efforts, Her Highness has been delighted. It's been far too long since we've seen her smile.
say:20:1321733017:0.source_cn: 我们仿照冬日祭典准备了许多有趣的项目——你们来时应该看...

say:22:1321733019:0.text: Of course! During all the preparations, I scarcely left her side for a moment!
say:22:1321733019:0.source_cn: 当然，筹备时，我与公主殿下寸步不离！

say:24:1321733020:0.text: Thank you for letting us know, Miss Lydia. May the goddess protect Princess Yolena.
say:24:1321733020:0.source_cn: ……感谢你的告知，莉娅女士。愿女神护佑公主殿下。

say:25:1321733021:0.text: The Valesa Court also extends its gratitude and thanks for your blessings upon Her Highness.
say:25:1321733021:0.source_cn: 那么，瓦勒沙宫廷也向您致意，感谢您对公主殿下的祝福。

narration:26:1321733022:0.text: After exchanging pleasantries with Miss Lydia, Temesia pulls you all aside.
narration:26:1321733022:0.source_cn: 向莉娅匆匆致意后，特弥希娅将你们拉到一旁

say:34:1321733025:0.text: I sense a faint trace of dark energy lingering on her. It is weak but unmistakable.
say:34:1321733025:0.source_cn: 她身上似乎残留着邪恶的气息……虽然很微弱，并不强烈，但...

say:35:1321733026:0.text: It's similar to the energy we detected in the Sun Temple when Berial arrived. This could make her more susceptible to bad influences.
say:35:1321733026:0.source_cn: 准确地说，就像是恶魔贝利尔现世后，日神殿里建筑物上沾染...

say:39:1321733028:0.text: What should we do now, Magister?
say:39:1321733028:0.source_cn: 魔法师大人，我们现在该怎么办？
say:39:1321733028:0.male: What should we do now, Magister?
say:39:1321733028:0.female: What should we do now, Magister?

choice_prompt:40:1321733028.text: What should we do now, Magister?
choice_prompt:40:1321733028.source_cn: 魔法师大人，我们现在该怎么办？
choice_prompt:40:1321733028.male: What should we do now, Magister?
choice_prompt:40:1321733028.female: What should we do now, Magister?

say:44:1321733030:0.text: Miss Lydia... I apologize for my earlier words. I meant no offense.
say:44:1321733030:0.source_cn: 莉娅女士……我为自己之前不经思考的话语致歉。

say:45:1321733031:0.text: Where is Princess Yolena? I wish to personally apologize and offer my well wishes for the celebration.
say:45:1321733031:0.source_cn: 公主殿下在哪？我想向她亲自道歉，并祝她在庆典玩得愉快。

say:46:1321733032:0.text: Her Highness is wandering about the castle, as lively as a sprite blessed by the goddess. You should see the light in her eyes!
say:46:1321733032:0.source_cn: 殿下正在城堡里四处游玩，她就像是环绕在女神旁的小精灵，...

say:47:1321733033:0.text: I suggest you and your lieutenant take this opportunity to relax. You both appear far too tense, which may be why you have had nightmares and unsettling visions.
say:47:1321733033:0.source_cn: 建议你和副官也趁着这个机会放松一下。你们精神过于紧张，...

say:48:1321733034:0.text: Here, take this petal collection card.
say:48:1321733034:0.source_cn: 给，拿好这张花瓣收集卡。

say:49:1321733035:0.text: You may exchange it for gifts, just as in the Snowspire Festival of Cedartown. Best of luck to you.
say:49:1321733035:0.source_cn: 和雪松镇上的冬日祭典一样，这张收集卡也可以拿来换取礼物...

say:50:1321733036:0.text: Now, I must go fetch Her Highness' favorite velvet shawl.
say:50:1321733036:0.source_cn: 我要去为公主殿下拿她最爱的天鹅绒披肩了。

choice:40:0:1.text: Let's go along with her words.
choice:40:0:1.source_cn: 继续顺着她的话说，不要刺激她
choice:40:0:1.male: Let's go along with her words.
choice:40:0:1.female: Let's go along with her words.

choice:40:1:2.text: Our priority is to find Yolena.
choice:40:1:2.source_cn: 想方设法找到亚莲娜公主！

choice:40:1:2.female: Our priority is to find Yolena.

say:52:1321733012:0.source_cn: 怎么，你要连大公阁下一并诅咒吗？艾雅在上，大公阁下已经...

say:53:1321733013:0.text: Dura bears witness—my loyalty to the Valesa family, to the Archduke, and to Princess Yolena remains steadfast!
say:53:1321733013:0.source_cn: 艾雅见证，我对瓦勒沙家族、对大公阁下与亚莲娜公主的虔敬...
